name: BanglaLekha-Isolated: A multi-purpose comprehensive dataset of Handwritten Bangla Isolated characters
description: BanglaLekha-Isolated is a comprehensive multi-subject dataset of handwritten isolated Bangla characters, numerals, and compound characters. Compiled by researchers at the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh, it features 166,105 handwritten character samples across 84 categories contributed by 2,000 native writers of diverse age, gender, and demographic background.
